authorizes: nothing: no test generation, no student run, no GPU

sets.comparator_selection: new family-disjoint set, used ONLY to name the strongest single deployable teacher
sets.test: new family-disjoint set, sealed until the student, comparator and this protocol are frozen
forbidden_sources: any P1-12/P1-13/P1-14 TRAIN or counterfactual scenario
any development family used for model selection

design.matching: student and all five teachers run on the identical scenario, seed and simulator code

comparator_rule.data: comparator_selection set totals only; never test outcomes
comparator_rule.deployable: a retained registry identity that, running alone on the comparator-selection set, meets the frozen latency_ms limits on the deployment hardware; a non-deployable teacher is ranked and reported, never the comparator; a per-scenario hindsight best is never deployable

oracle: per-scenario best teacher in hindsight; reported separately; never a deployable baseline

primary.contrast: student minus comparator, paired per scenario, averaged per family
primary.test: one-sided family bootstrap, upper bound of the mean family difference < 0

latency_ms.unit: per simulator step, whole joint map of all people (all chunk rows), raw student, deployment hardware
latency_ms.budget_rule: set before freeze from (1) the deployment step deadline (HLD A7, not yet documented) and (2) the measured GPU preflight: p99_max <= the step deadline; p50/p95 from the measured distribution plus a preregistered margin; no number is set from an estimate
gpu_measurements_required: A10 warm forward latency per row at 1k/4k/8k/16k tokens, batch 1, CUDA-synchronized
rows per step at N=50/100/110/200 with the chosen chunk size k (reservations make rows sequential)
end-to-end step latency incl. tokenization and transfer, n>=100 steps for p99
cold start excluded and reported apart
the same measurement for every teacher alone on the deployment CPU (deployable flag)
latency_ms.evidence_now: A10 inspect attempt 7: one call, N=3, 617 input tokens, 113.4 s client elapsed incl. container start; no forward timing; does not support any limit

guards.point_estimates: the family-mean casualties and unresolved differences must also be <= 0
guards.severe_regression_rule: a scenario regresses severely when ANY listed outcome is worse than the comparator by >= max(min_people, fraction_of_people * N)
guards.severe_regression_rate_bound: one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound at alpha_one_sided over scenarios
guards.safety_failures_definition: simulator-safety: invalid or incomplete joint map, simulator error, fail-closed step (token overflow, invalid logits), episode not completed
guards.model_input_privacy_definition: any private simulator field (hidden fire schedule, RNG state, future steps, teacher output) found in a model input by the privacy audit; null (not audited) makes the run INVALID

secondary.vs_each_teacher: same primary test against every teacher, Holm adjustment over 5 at one-sided 0.025

not_success: beating the oracle is not required

claims.casualties_plus_unresolved_improved: primary test passes and every guard holds
claims.casualties_improved: primary claim plus casualties superior on its own (upper bound < 0) and Holm over {casualties, unresolved} at alpha
claims.both_improved: primary claim plus casualties AND unresolved upper bounds < 0 (intersection-union test, no adjustment)
claims.rule: SUPERIOR claims only the primary outcome; 'fewer casualties and fewer unresolved' needs both_improved
